resources.string:
The AH-1W Super Cobra is an American attack helicopter.
The AH-1W Super Cobra entered service in 1986.
The AH-1W Super Cobra is a tandem two-seat helicopter with the gunner in front and the pilot in the rear.
Cannon: 20 mm / Air-to-ground missiles / Rockets: 70 mm.
Crew: 2.

The AH-64 Apache is an American attack helicopter. It was developed in the 1970s-1980s.
Entered service in September 1984.
The AH-64 Apache has undergone several modernization campaigns significantly improving its capabilities.
The AH-64D Apache Longbow version can receive an AN/APG-78 Longbow millimeter-wave radar installed above the main rotor.
The AH-64E Apache Guardian version is the most modern currently in service.
The AH-64 Apache, in different versions, is widely exported worldwide.
Cannon: 30 mm M230, capacity 1,200 rounds.
Air-to-ground missiles: up to 16.
Air-to-air missiles: 2.
Rockets: 70 mm.
Crew: 2.
The CH-47 Chinook is an American heavy transport helicopter. It entered service in 1962.

The Ka-50 Black Shark (Hokum-A in NATO designation) is a Russian reconnaissance and attack helicopter.\nIt was developed in the Soviet Union in the 1980s.\nThe first flight took place on June 17, 1982. The Ka-50 entered service in 1995.

The Ka-52 Alligator (Hokum-B in NATO designation) is a Russian reconnaissance and attack helicopter.
It was developed in the 1990s-2000s.
The Ka-52 entered service in 2011.
Models: Ka-50 – single-seat / Ka-52 – two-seat / Ka-52K Katran – naval version / Ka-52M – entered service in 2023.
Cannon: 30 mm.
Shturm-VU anti-tank missiles.
Igla-V air-to-air missiles.
Rockets: S-8, S-13.
Crew: 2.

The Mi-8 (Hip – NATO code) is a Russian multi-role transport helicopter. It was developed in the Soviet Union in the 1950s-1960s.
The Mi-8 entered service in 1965.
The Mi-8 has undergone numerous modernization campaigns with a wide range of models.
It gave birth to the Mi-14 Haze with amphibious capability, and the Mi-17 and Mi-171 export versions.
The Mi-8 is very widely distributed worldwide. More than 50 countries use it in their armed forces or in civilian version.
Crew: 3.
Range: 650 km.

The Mi-24 (Hind – NATO code) is a Russian attack helicopter.
It was developed in the Soviet Union in the 1960s.
The Mi-24 entered service in 1972.
The Mi-24 is designed using many systems from the Mi-8 transport helicopter.
It can receive a wide range of weapons: rockets, missiles and gun pods.
The Mi-24 can carry a group of eight soldiers in the compartment behind the cockpit.
The first version Mi-24A has a three-member crew cockpit in 1 + 2 configuration.
From the Mi-24B model, it is replaced by a tandem cockpit.
The Mi-24 is very widely distributed worldwide.
Nearly sixty countries use it in their armed forces.
More than 3,500 units have been produced, all models combined.
Machine gun: Yak-B rotary 4 x 12.7 mm.
Cannon: GSh-23L 23 mm.
Cannon: GSh-30K 30 mm.
Rockets: S-5, S-8, S-13, S-24.
Air-to-ground missiles: Shturm-V, Ataka-M.
Air-to-air missiles: Igla-V, R-60M, R-63V.
Crew: 2 + 8 soldiers.
Range: 1000 km.

The Mi-26 (Halo – NATO code) is a Russian heavy transport helicopter. It was developed in the Soviet Union in the 1970s.
The Mi-26 entered service in 1983.
Crew: 5-6.
Service ceiling: 4600 m.
Payload: 20,000 kg.
Range: 800 km.

The Mi-28 (Havoc in NATO designation) is a Russian attack helicopter. It was developed in the Soviet Union, then in Russia in the 1980s-2000s.
It entered service in 2008 in Mi-28N version.
On August 16, 1996, Mil unveiled the Mi-28N Notchnoi Okhotnik – Night Hunter version, capable of night combat.
The Mi-28N is a tandem two-seat helicopter designed for attack and anti-tank combat missions.
In 2012, Iraq ordered fifteen Mi-28N delivered in 2014-2016. In March 2014, Algeria ordered forty-two Mi-28N.
Versions: Mi-28 / Mi-28N / Mi-28NE / Mi-28UB / Mi-28NM.
Cannon: 2A42 30 mm.
Rockets: S-8, S-13.
Air-to-ground missiles: Shturm-V, Ataka-V.
Air-to-air missiles: Igla-V.
Crew: 2.
Range: 450 km.

The CH-53 Stallion is an American heavy transport helicopter. It was developed in the 1960s.
The CH-53 Stallion entered service in 1966.
The CH-53 Stallion is a heavy transport helicopter with a maximum takeoff weight of 19,050 kg.
It is capable of transporting thirty-eight equipped soldiers.
Stallion was delivered from April 22, 2022.
Versions: CH-53A / CH-53D / CH-53G / CH-53D / MH-53 / CH-53E Super Stallion / CH-53K King Stallion.

The UH-60 Black Hawk is an American multi-role transport helicopter. It was developed in the 1970s.
The UH-60 Black Hawk entered service in 1979.
The UH-60 Black Hawk has been derived into many versions:
for Special Forces, naval version for the Navy, for the Coast Guard,
search and rescue missions, medical evacuation,
VIP transport and versions for transporting specific equipment:
radar, C3 Command-Control-Communication, weapons.
The UH-60 Black Hawk has been produced in more than four thousand units for about thirty countries worldwide.

The A129 Mangusta is an Italian attack helicopter. It was developed in the 1980s.
The A129 Mangusta entered service in 1990.
It is a tandem two-seat helicopter with the pilot in the rear and the gunner in the front.
The A129 Mangusta served as the basis for the Turkish T129 ATAK attack helicopter, produced by TAI with technology transfer.
Cannon: 20 mm.
Pod machine gun: 12.7 mm.
Air-to-ground missiles: AGM-114 Hellfire.
Air-to-air missiles: 2 x AIM-92 Stinger, Mistral.
Rockets: 70 mm, 81 mm.
Crew: 2.
Ceiling: 4,425 m.
Range: 510 km.

The Airbus A330 Multi Role Tanker Transport (MRTT) is a wide-body military transport and refueling aircraft model developed and built by Airbus.
Entered service in 2011.
Derived from the A330 airliner, it is a multi-role aircraft allowing simultaneous troop and material transport as well as air refueling.
The A330 MRTT has a maximum fuel capacity of 111,000 kg at takeoff.

The A400M Atlas is a European transport aircraft. It was developed in the 2000s-2010s.
The A400M Atlas entered service on December 29, 2013.
Crew: 3 to 4.
Passengers: 116.
Maximum load: 37,000 kg of cargo.
Ceiling: 12,192 m.
Range: 4,800 km with 30 tons of cargo.
Maximum takeoff weight: 141,000 kg.

The Lockheed C-130J Super Hercules is a tactical transport aircraft (TTA) or assault aircraft (AA),
when self-protected and armored.
Max offered load: 18.7 t.
Max number of passengers: 128.
Max number of pallets in hold + ramp: 7 + 1.

Tactical logistics and cargo transport aircraft,
produced from 1963 to 1981 by a Franco-German consortium. Entered service 1965.
It has an air refueling capability for fighters or another C-160.
It transports up to 16 tons of equipment or 89 passengers.
Range: 4400 km.
In May 2022, the last Transall of the French Air Force were retired.
The Transall remains in service in Turkey and Australia.
Entered service in 2006, the H225M Caracal designed by Airbus Helicopters is the latest standard of the Puma SA330 family.\nCapable of transporting up to 28 combatants.\nMaximum load - 11.2 tons.

The CN-235 is a tactical transport aircraft. It was developed in the 1980s-1990s by Airtech.
The CN-235 entered service on March 1, 1988.
The CN-235 can transport up to 44 passengers or 4 cargo pallets in cargo version. The maximum payload is 6,000 kg.
The French Air and Space Force employs 27 CN-235 distributed among six air bases.
The CN-235 is employed by 29 countries, including France, Spain, the United States, Turkey, Pakistan, Ireland and South Korea.

The Z-20 is a Chinese transport helicopter. It has been in development since the 1990s.
The first flight of the Z-20 took place on December 23, 2013.
The design of the Z-20 is heavily inspired by the American Sikorsky UH-60 Black Hawk transport helicopter,
whose S-70C-2 version has been used by the Chinese army since 1984.
Crew: 2 + 12.
Maximum takeoff weight: 10,000 kg.

The Z-10 is a Chinese attack helicopter. It was developed in the 1990s-2000s.
The Z-10 entered service in 2011.
The Z-10 is an all-weather multi-role attack helicopter.
It is intended for anti-tank combat missions, ground support and armed reconnaissance.
It has an armored cockpit, tandem two-seat with the pilot in front and the gunner in the rear.
Cannon: 23 mm.
Rockets: 57 mm, 90 mm.
Air-to-ground missiles: HJ-10, HJ-9, HJ-8.
Air-to-air missiles: TY-90, PL-5, PL-7, PL-9.
Crew: 2.
Ceiling: 6,400 m.
Range: 800 km.

The F-16 Fighting Falcon is an American fighter aircraft. It was developed in the 1970s.
The F-16 Fighting Falcon entered service in 1978.
The F-16 Fighting Falcon is widely distributed worldwide with more than 4,500 aircraft built, all versions combined.
It has been assembled under license in South Korea, Turkey, the Netherlands and Belgium.
Part of the F-16 fleet is being replaced by F-35 Lightning II stealth fighters.

The F-35 Lightning II is an American stealth fighter aircraft. It was developed in the 1990s-2000s.
It entered service in 2015 in its F-35A version.
The F-35 is a fifth-generation stealth aircraft.
It is capable of carrying missiles or bombs on four internal bay locations and six external pylons.
The F-35 is widely exported worldwide: United Kingdom / Italy / Netherlands / Israel / Australia / Japan / South Korea / Norway / Denmark / Belgium / Poland / Singapore / United Arab Emirates / Finland / Turkey.
Cannon: GAU-22A, 4×25 mm.
Internal bays: 4 missiles/bombs.
External pylons: 6 pylons 6,800 kg of weapons.
Crew: 1.
Maximum speed: 1,930 km/h.
Ceiling: 18,500 m.
Range: F-35A 1,080 km / F-35B 869 km / F-35C 1,138 km.
Maximum weight: 25,600 kg.

The Fennec is a military version of the Ecureuil helicopter family from Airbus Helicopters. Entered service in 1988.
It has been adopted for observation, patrol, escort, combat, light attack and training missions.
Equipped with 20 mm axial cannon capability and the possibility of embarking a sniper on the right side door.
Maximum passengers: 4 airmen.
Max load: 2.3 tons.

The Ilyushin Il-76, Candid in NATO designation, is a Russian transport aircraft.
It was developed in the Soviet Union in the 1960s-1970s.
The Ilyushin Il-76 entered service in 1974.
Crew: 5 (+ 2 loadmasters).
Passengers: 126 armed paratroopers or 150 soldiers.
Maximum load: 48,000 kg of cargo.
Ceiling: 12,000 m.
Range: 3,800 km at maximum load, 7,300 km with 20,000 kg.

The Ka-27 (Helix-A in NATO designation) is a Russian naval helicopter. It was developed in the Soviet Union in the 1970s.
The Ka-27 entered service in 1981.
The two main models are the Ka-27PL, ProtivoLodotchnyi – anti-submarine, and the Ka-27PS, Poiskovo-Spasatelnyï – search and rescue.
The Ka-27PL is intended for detection and destruction of submarines with a range of up to 200 km from its base.
The Ka-27 is in service in Russia, Ukraine, Vietnam, India, China, Algeria.
The MiG-29, Fulcrum in NATO designation, is a Russian fighter aircraft.\nIt was developed in the Soviet Union in the 1970s-1980s.\nThe MiG-29 entered service in July 1983.

The MiG-31, Foxhound in NATO designation, is a Russian interceptor aircraft. It was developed in the Soviet Union in the 1970s.
The MiG-31 entered service on May 6, 1981.
Production of MiG-31 was stopped in 1994.
It is employed by the Russian and Kazakh air forces.
From 2008, the Russian MiG-31 fleet underwent a modernization campaign to MiG-31BM standard.
Cannon: Gsh-6-23M rotary 6 x 23 mm.
Long-range air-to-air missiles.
Medium-range air-to-air missiles.
Short-range air-to-air missiles.
Air-to-surface missiles.
Crew: 2.
Maximum ceiling: 30,000 m.

The Mirage 2000 is a fighter aircraft designed by the French company Dassault Aviation, in the late 1970s.
Range of more than 1,500 km with standard weapons.
The Mirage 2000 typically carries two short-range air-to-air missiles (Magic II type),
two medium-range air-to-air missiles (Super 530 or MICA type),
as well as various pylons capable of accommodating bombs,
additional fuel tanks or reconnaissance pods.
The MALE MQ-9 Reaper drone, from the French Air Force, deployed at the forward air base in Niamey, Niger.

The Tornado is a European combat aircraft. It was developed in the 1970s.
The Tornado entered service in 1979.
The Tornado was designed by Panavia formed by British aircraft manufacturer BAC, British Aircraft Corporation, (42.5%%),
German Messerschmitt-Bölkow-Blohm (42.5%%) and Italian Aeritalia (15%%).
The Tornado was produced in nearly 1,000 units.
It was retired from service of the British RAF, Royal Air Force, in 2019.
The Tornado was exported to Saudi Arabia.
The PC-21 is the new and latest training aircraft for fighter crews of the Air and Space Force.

The Rafale is a French fighter aircraft. It was developed in the 1980s-1990s.
The Rafale entered service on May 18, 2001.
The Rafale can perform a wide range of missions.
From the F3 standard, the Rafale received the designation "omnirole"
thanks to its ability to perform all types of missions during the same flight and simultaneously.
For export, the Rafale was ordered by Egypt in 24 units on February 16, 2015,
Qatar in 36 units including 24 on May 4, 2015 and 12 on December 7, 2017,
India in 36 units on September 23, 2016 and Greece.
Versions: Rafale C – single-seat / Rafale B – two-seat / Rafale M single-seat for the Navy.
Russian heavy combat drone. The possible technical characteristics of the aircraft are unknown.

The Puma SA 330 performs search and rescue missions,
EVASAN missions (medical evacuations) and troop transport.
This helicopter is used in ALAT (Army Light Aviation).
It is permanently used for rescue missions but also in OPEX
(External Operations: Harmattan, Serval, Epervier, Sangaris and Barkhane).
This helicopter is used in the permanent operation against illegal gold mining in French Guiana.
Max mass - 7.4 tons.
Its endurance is two hours (+ 20 minutes reserve).
It can transport up to 16 to 20 passengers or a sling load of 1,500 kg.
The Puma can be armed with 7.62 mm machine guns,
rocket pods, anti-tank missiles or even a 20 mm cannon on the side.

The Su-27, Flanker in NATO designation, is a Russian fighter aircraft.
It was developed in the Soviet Union in the 1970s-1980s.
The Su-27 entered service in 1985.
The Su-27 is armed with the Gryazev-Shipunov GSh-30-1 30 mm cannon.
It can receive a wide range of missiles, rockets and bombs on ten hardpoints.
The Su-27 is developed in two-seat version Su-27UB.
The Su-27 is one of the main fighter aircraft of the Russian Air Forces.
It is in service in the former USSR countries: Belarus, Ukraine, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan and Moldova.
It has been exported to China, Angola, Vietnam, Indonesia, Mongolia, Ethiopia and Eritrea.

The Su-57, Felon in NATO designation, is a Russian stealth fighter aircraft.
It was developed in the 2000s-2010s.
The Su-57 entered service in 2021.
The Su-57 is a fifth-generation fighter.
Cannon: 9-A1-4071K 30 mm.
Internal bays: 10 missiles/bombs.
External pylons: 8 missiles/bombs.
Crew: 1.
Operational ceiling: 20,000 m.

The Tiger is a Franco-German attack helicopter. It was developed in the 1980s-1990s.
The Tiger entered service in April 2005.
The Tiger is an all-weather multi-role attack helicopter.
It is intended for armed reconnaissance, attack, anti-tank combat, ground troop support missions.
It has a tandem cockpit with the pilot in front and the gunner in the rear.
The Tiger is air-transportable by C-130, A-400M transport aircraft.
Cannon: 30 mm.
Rockets: 68 mm, 70 mm.
Air-to-ground missiles: Hellfire II, HOT 3.
Air-to-air missiles: Mistral, Stinger.
Crew: 2.
Service ceiling: 2000 m.
Range: 800 km.

The Typhoon is a European fighter aircraft. The first flight took place on March 27, 1994.
The Typhoon entered service in 2004.
The Typhoon is also known by the designation EF-2000.
It is a twin-engine, multi-role fighter, developed by the Eurofighter consortium,
composed of the United Kingdom, Germany, Italy and Spain.
Cannon: 27 mm, Mauser BK-27.
External pylons: 8 underwing pylons, 5 under fuselage, 9,000 kg of weapons.
Air-to-air missiles: AIM-9 Sidewinder, AIM-120 AMRAAM, AIM-132 AMRAAM.
Air-to-ground missiles: AGM-88 HARM, AGM-65 Maverick, Storm Shadow.
Bombs: Paveway II.
Crew: 1.
Ceiling: 19,800 m.
Range: 1,389 km.
Endurance: 2,900 km, 3,790 km with 3 refuelings.

The F-22 Raptor is an American stealth fighter aircraft. It was developed in the 1980s.
The first flight took place on September 29, 1990. The F-22 Raptor entered service on December 15, 2005.
The F-22 Raptor's armament consists of an internal six-barrel M61A2 Vulcan 20 mm rotary cannon and three internal weapon bays.
It can receive up to 9 t of weapons or fuel tanks on four external pylons.
Production of the F-22 Raptor was stopped in 2011.
The initial goal of 700 aircraft was reduced to 187 aircraft, plus eight prototypes.
The United States is the only country to employ the F-22 Raptor.
Cannon: M61A2 Vulcan 6 x 20 mm,
Internal bays: 8 missiles/bombs.
External pylons: 8 missiles/bombs or 4 fuel tanks.
Air-to-air missiles: AIM-120 AMRAAM, AIM-9 Sidewinder.
Bombs: JDAM, GBU-39 Small Diameter Bombs.
Crew: 1.
Ceiling: 19,812 m.
Range: 2,960 km.
The J-10, Firebird in NATO designation, is a Chinese fighter aircraft. It was developed in the 1990s.\nThe J-10 entered service in 2005.

The MiG-35, Fulcrum-F in NATO designation, is a Russian fighter aircraft. It was developed in the 2000s-2010s.
The MiG-35 entered service in 2019.
The MiG-35 is a generation 4++ fighter. It is a deep modernization of the MiG-29M/M2 fighter aircraft.
The MiG-35 integrates a wide range of air-to-air and air-to-surface weapons.
It can be deployed on roughly prepared airfields.
The MiG-35 can be used as an air refueling aircraft.

The Wing Loong (or Pterodactyl) is a medium-altitude long-endurance combat drone, built by a Chinese company.
Role: Reconnaissance and attack drone.
Maximum mass: 1,100 kg.
Maximum speed: 280 km/h.
Ceiling: 5,300 m.
Range: 4,000 km.
The Mirage IV is a French strategic bomber whose studies began in the mid-1950s.\nEntered service in 1964.

The B-1B Lancer is an American strategic bomber. It was developed in the 1970s-1980s.
The B-1B Lancer entered service on October 1, 1986.
The United States is the only country to employ the B-1B Lancer.
Cannon: 30 mm GSh-30-1.
Payload: 56,700 kg.
Air-to-ground missiles: AGM-154, AGM-158 / x 24 max.
Bombs: Mk-82, Mk-84, Mk-62, CBU-87/89/97, CBU-103/104/105, CBU-31, CBU-38.
Crew: 4.
Operational ceiling: 18,000 m.
Range: 5,543 km.
Maximum distance: 12,000 km.
Maximum takeoff weight: 216,400 kg.

The Tu-22M (Backfire in NATO designation) is a Russian strategic bomber.
It was developed in the Soviet Union in the 1960s-1970s.
The Tu-22M entered service in 1974.
The Tu-22M is a supersonic variable-geometry long-range bomber.
Production of Tu-22M3 was stopped in 1993.
The Tu-22M has never been exported.
Currently, Russia is the only country to employ this type of aircraft after its retirement from service of the Ukrainian Air Force.
Bombs: KAB-500.
Naval mines: FAB-250.
Crew: 4.
Maximum takeoff weight: 126,000 kg.
Range: 2,410 km.

The H-6 is a Chinese long-range bomber. It is produced by Xian Aircraft Industrial Corporation.
The H-6 entered service in February 1969.
Currently, China is the only country to employ H-6 bombers.
Crew: 2.
Ceiling: 12,800 m.
Range: 1,800 km.

The AH-6 Little Bird is an American light reconnaissance and attack helicopter.
It was developed in the 2000s-2010s by Boeing.
The AH-6 Little Bird is intended for reconnaissance and light attack missions.
Four hardpoints can receive an M-134 Minigun 7.62 mm rotary machine gun,
a GAU-19 12.7 mm machine gun, an M3P 12.7 mm machine gun, M260 rockets and AGM-114 Hellfire anti-tank missiles.
Crew: 1 – 2.
Maximum takeoff weight: 1,610 kg.

The CSH-2 Rooivalk is a South African attack helicopter. It was developed in the 1980s-2010s.
The CSH-2 Rooivalk entered service in 2011.
The crew of the CSH-2 Rooivalk consists of two people, with the pilot in the rear and the gunner in the front of the aircraft.
The helicopter is armed with the GA-1 Rattler 20 mm cannon. Depending on the mission, it can receive ZT-6 Mokopa anti-tank missiles,
air-to-air missiles and unguided rocket pods.

The NH90 is a European transport helicopter.
It was developed in the 1980s-2000s by NHIndustries.
The first flight took place on December 18, 1995. The NH90 entered service in 2007.
In the French army, it bears the name NH90 Caïman.

The V-22B Osprey is an American tiltrotor transport helicopter. It was developed in the 1980s-2000s.
The V-22B Osprey entered service in 2005.
The V-22B Osprey is intended for rapid troop transport and amphibious or ground assault missions.
It is equipped with two turboprops and two independent rotors mounted at the ends of the wing.
The propulsion-rotor unit has the ability to tilt for vertical takeoff and landing, and horizontal propulsion,
like an airplane, allows it a speed of 566 km/h.
The V-22B Osprey can transport up to 12 equipped soldiers or 4,500kg of internal load or 6,800 kg of external load.
